facts.value: Three transferable 4-credit college laboratory science courses from the following: biology, chemistry, earth science or physics.
An integrated laboratory science or advanced-level laboratory-based science may be substituted for one of these laboratory subjects.
Students are required to complete three different lab sciences.

One transferable 3-credit college social science course.

facts.value: ASU offers merit-based scholarships for international first-year and transfer students. You are automatically considered when you apply for admission — no separate application is needed.
Tuition and fees vary depending on your program. You can estimate your total cost using ASU's cost of attendance calculator.

ASU may offer conditional admission to international applicants who meet the academic (aptitude) requirements but who are not proficient in English. Conditional admission gives international F-1 students three semesters to submit a passing TOEFL, IELTS or PTE score, or to successfully graduate from ASU Global Launch to be fully admitted to the university.

value: Applicants who have completed their junior and senior years in a U.S. high school with an SAT EBRW score of 580 taken after April 2016 or an ACT English score of 23.

Applicants who have completed a minimum of 48 transferable semester credits including six credits of freshman English composition at a U.S. college or university with a cumulative GPA of 2.50 or higher.
Applicants holding a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. college or university.
Applicants who have completed four years of high school in a U.S. high school are subject to high school competency requirements.
TOEFL score of at least 550 (PBT) or 80 (iBT). ASU’s institutional code is 4007. ASU accepts only electronic copies of the TOEFL score report.
IELTS overall band score of at least 6.5. No institutional code is needed.
